## Generate 5-Fold Cross-Validation Illustration

```{r}
#| label: fig-cv-viz
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

# Data for 5 folds
folds_data <- expand_grid(
  fold = 1:5,
  set = factor(1:5)
) |>
  mutate(
    type = if_else(as.numeric(set) == fold, "Validation", "Training")
  )

# Define stratification representation (6 colored bars per subset)
strat_data <- expand_grid(
  set = factor(1:5),
  category = factor(1:6)
) |>
  mutate(
    cat_num = as.numeric(category)
  )

# Colors for CV sets
cv_colors <- c("Training" = "#e3f2fd", "Validation" = "#fff3e0")
cv_border <- c("Training" = "#1e88e5", "Validation" = "#fb8c00")

# Colors for Stratification (6 distinct professional colors)
strat_colors <- c("#66c2a5", "#fc8d62", "#8da0cb", "#e78ac3", "#a6d854", "#ffd92f")

# Legend data for categories - Capitalized for publication
cat_legend <- tibble(
  num = 1:6,
  label = c("Stable_normal", "Normal2mci", "Stable_mci", "Normal2incid", "Mci2incid", "Prev")
)

# Plot the folds
p_cv <- ggplot() +
  # Draw the Training/Validation tiles
  geom_tile(data = folds_data, aes(x = as.numeric(set), y = fold, fill = type, color = type), 
            width = 0.8, height = 0.6, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = folds_data, aes(x = as.numeric(set), y = fold, label = type), 
            size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  
  # Draw mini stratification bars
  geom_rect(data = strat_data, 
            aes(xmin = as.numeric(set) - 0.4 + (as.numeric(category)-1)*0.133, 
                xmax = as.numeric(set) - 0.4 + as.numeric(category)*0.133,
                ymin = -0.2, ymax = 0.1, fill = factor(cat_num)), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  
  # Add numbers 1-6 in the blocks
  geom_text(data = strat_data,
            aes(x = as.numeric(set) - 0.4 + (as.numeric(category)-0.5)*0.133,
                y = -0.05, label = cat_num), size = 2.2, fontface = "bold") +
  
  # Manual labels for Folds
  annotate("text", x = 0.3, y = 1:5, label = paste("Fold", 1:5), 
           hjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
  
  # Manual labels for Subsets
  annotate("text", x = 1:5, y = -0.5, label = paste("Subset", 1:5), 
           fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
  
  # Manual labels at left
  # Align "Dementia Transition" with Fold 1 (y=1)
  # annotate("text", x = -0.4, y = 1, label = "Dementia\nTransition", 
  #          hjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 4, color = "black", lineheight = 0.9) +
  
  # Align "Data Subsets" with color blocks (y approx -0.05)
  # annotate("text", x = -0.4, y = -0.05, label = "Data\nSubsets", 
  #          hjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 4, color = "black", lineheight = 0.9) +
  
  # Right side ensemble arrow
  annotate("segment", x = 5.6, y = 1, xend = 5.6, yend = 5, 
           arrow = arrow(ends = "both", length = unit(0.2, "cm")), color = "grey40") +
  annotate("text", x = 6.0, y = 3, label = "Average\nEnsemble", 
           angle = 270, fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
  
  # Bottom Legend for categories
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = -1.2, label = "Dementia Transition Category:",
           hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = -1.6,
           label = paste(glue("{cat_legend$num}: {cat_legend$label}"), collapse = "  |  "),
           hjust = 0, size = 3.2, color = "grey20") +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(cv_colors, set_names(strat_colors, 1:6))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cv_border) +
  labs(title = "5-Fold Stratified Cross-Validation") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off", xlim = c(-1.5, 6.2), ylim = c(-1.8, 5.5)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16, margin = margin(b = 20)),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# Display and save
print(p_cv)

# Save to output
fs::dir_create(here("VAE/lite/VAE_graph/output"))
ggsave(here("VAE/lite/VAE_graph/output/vae_cv_pub.png"), p_cv, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
write_rds(p_cv, here("VAE/lite/VAE_graph/output/vae_cv_pub.rds"))
```
